use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building semantic search and contextual recommendations. Primary workloads: large-scale nightly batch embeddings (~5M vectors), hourly incremental updates (~50k/hr), and low-latency user query path targeting <150ms 95th pctl for search queries. Need embedding vector storage in their managed vector DB with robust connector + fallback routing to cheaper model variants during spikes.
requirements_summary: Throughput: support embedding batch jobs with parallelization and resumable uploads. Query SLA: 95th pctl <150ms for opensearch-like search surface. Integration: connector to Pinecone/Milvus or their hosted vector DB; prefer turnkey integration from Redwood Optimize. Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs, optional EU residency. Pricing: predictable per-embedding pricing; evaluating tradeoff between hosted unit-cost vs Dedicated committed capacity + burst pricing. POC success criteria defined (latency, throughput, connector stability, cost per 1M embeddings).
poc_metrics_target: cost_target: <= $0.60 per 1k embeddings (hosted baseline) or better on Dedicated
